status: prototype; not a Hub contract or production guarantee

entries.evidence: Source inspection, not speech generation or playback testing
entries.finding: The inspected AudioChunk API carries the loaded voice's sample rate, 2-byte samples and one channel. A consumer must preserve that format or explicitly convert it.
entries.action: Read the matching voice JSON and actual AudioChunk metadata; configure playback accordingly or verify resampling. Do not assume all voices use one rate.
entries.limits: No old-package compatibility, playback latency, hardware fit, voice rights or finished narration quality is established.

entries.finding: The inspected iterator yields after synthesizing a sentence. The presence of an iterator does not establish continuous low-latency playback.
entries.action: Measure synthesis and playback lifecycle independently before relying on a latency bound.
entries.limits: Does not diagnose a particular application's buffering or interruption behavior.

entries.evidence: Founder-controlled deterministic check of unchanged saved Python code; no media render
entries.finding: Rounding 101..104 ms to nearest 10 ms gives 100..100 ms, which the saved tool rejects.
entries.action: Choose a documented quantization policy, then validate positive duration, ordering, bounds and overlap. Never invent timing silently.
entries.limits: This prototype checks supplied interval shape and positive duration only. Use the full saved tool's input validator for its complete contract.

entries.evidence: Founder-controlled deterministic source check; output unchanged when external trim metadata was added
entries.finding: The saved tool consumes supplied word times and cannot discover that the audio was trimmed or retimed.
entries.action: Establish the final audio timebase. Apply and check the actual edit map, or obtain a new alignment when mapping is unavailable.
entries.limits: An unchanged format-valid ASS file can still be out of sync. This checker does not inspect audio.
